pll2d14c6-d1e3519.summary: Asks why 'God saw that it was good' is not said here as for the other days, and suggests a mystery: perhaps because two is the beginning of otherness and the sign of division.
claims: The second day lacks 'it was good' perhaps because two signifies division.

pl-l2d14c6.summary: Asks why 'God saw that it was good' is not said of the second day's work as of the others. Some mystery is commended: perhaps because two is the beginning of otherness and a sign of division.
claims: 'It was good' is omitted for the second day.
The omission may signify that two is the beginning of otherness and division.
